blockedReasons.summary: No reviewed local model asset input boundary exists.
No reviewed config/path boundary exists for model asset locations.
Checksum, size, format, and provenance evidence are absent.
Runtime readiness remains blocked and not evidence-backed.
No KV260 target session exists for model load handoff.
No reviewed model-load executor or runtime lifecycle exists.
Unload, cleanup, and rollback policy needs a reviewed runtime lifecycle.
Local-only policy must continue blocking provider and cloud fallback paths.

handoffRefs.summary: Model status display keeps model loading blocked and disabled.
Runtime readiness remains blocked and local-data only.
Device/session status reports no active target session.
Chat readiness keeps send and recovery actions blocked.
Local-only policy keeps provider, cloud, and fallback paths blocked.

limitations: Data-only chat model-load request fixture; no model asset path is configured, read, resolved, or emitted.
No model weights, tokenizer files, checksum manifests, configuration files, environment values, prompts, responses, transcripts, runtime logs, private paths, secrets, or tokens are read.

No model asset validation, checksum computation, runtime preflight, model load, model unload, model warmup, response generation, persistence, import, export, upload, telemetry, or artifact write is performed.
No KV260 hardware access, serial access, network call, provider call, pccx-lab invocation, or systemverilog-ide invocation is performed.
This is not a release, tag, compatibility commitment, MCP, LSP, IDE, marketplace, telemetry, runtime, model-loader, provider, storage, or hardware implementation.

loadControls.label: select model descriptor
loadControls.launcherAction: Render descriptor metadata from checked fixtures only.
loadControls.userAction: Review the target model descriptor in the future chat UI.

loadControls.label: configure asset path
loadControls.launcherAction: Keep asset path configuration disabled and do not read config or paths.
loadControls.userAction: Configure local assets only after a reviewed model-asset input boundary exists.

loadControls.label: validate assets
loadControls.launcherAction: Refuse asset validation and do not open model files or manifests.
loadControls.userAction: Validate assets only after integrity and redaction rules are reviewed.

loadControls.label: build load plan
loadControls.userAction: Build a load plan only after asset, runtime, and target-session evidence exists.

loadControls.label: start runtime
loadControls.userAction: Start runtime only after evidence-backed runtime and target-session readiness.

loadControls.label: load model
loadControls.launcherAction: Refuse model load and do not touch model assets or hardware.
loadControls.userAction: Load model only after assets, integrity, runtime, and device evidence are reviewed.

loadControls.label: warm up model
loadControls.launcherAction: Keep warmup disabled and do not execute inference.
loadControls.userAction: Warm up only after a model is loaded by a reviewed runtime path.

loadControls.label: unload model
loadControls.launcherAction: Keep unload disabled because no model is loaded.
loadControls.userAction: Unload only after a reviewed runtime lifecycle exists.

loadControls.label: persist load request
loadControls.launcherAction: Do not write policy, request, preference, or config files.
loadControls.userAction: Persist load requests only after local configuration storage is reviewed.
